name: Regina Cuadra
office: Fullerton Joint Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Regina Cuadra is a special education teacher in the La Habra City School District. She has served as a PTA president and is the treasurer of the teachers' union.

sentences.text: Regina Cuadra is a special education teacher in the La Habra City School District.
She has served as a PTA president and is the treasurer of the teachers' union.

items.text: In a 2026 candidate questionnaire, Cuadra said the district's top needs are stabilizing fiscal operations while protecting student programs, and modernizing campus facilities for safety and equity. At a candidate forum, she voiced support for Proposition 3, a school funding measure. Her campaign says she supports career and technical education and school safety improvements. Her campaign also states that her PTA grant-writing brought new funding to schools.
